name: FELT PIANO
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless generated solo piano. Felt hammers, a soft pedal, a quiet room.
description: FELT PIANO turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless solo pianist. Every few minutes a new piece in one of five idioms: a slow Gymnopedie-like waltz, Airport-style loops drifting out of phase, a felt ostinato that changes one note at a time, a nocturne, or sparse modal improvising. A modal felt-piano voice with soft hammers, beating unisons, dampers, sympathetic strings, pedal and key noise, in a gentle room. A piano roll scrolls on the screen, each note a light that fades as it rings. Fourteen presets, from Erik's Bowler to Coat Check; knobs for tempo, density, felt and room.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
